reviews.review_description: You pay a bit more, but have no hassles later. Very responsive, know their stuff, know the weaknesses of cheap systems and offer top quality. The right company if you want your product to last and be reliable.

The  sales and quoting process was very efficient. .The installation work was very neat and in a professional manner. The customer service was good . They helped install the wifi connection on my phone and informed me that I had to let my  electicity provider know that I had solar on.
The entire process was simple. The installers were polite and helpful.
This review is for Solaredge inverters.
Heinz Solar from Byron Bay NSW provided me with everything I asked for in the most efficient manner

The quoting was done promptly and a number of options were provided. These options were modified as we discussed the system design.The installation was completed in a very short time frame and the workmanship was of a high standard.Unfortunately I wasn't around at the time of the install, so I couldn't ask some of the system specific questions related to my particular site and these details have been a bit difficult to follow up with afterwards.

Heinz solar has proven to be well run, efficient, up to date with the world's best equipment and quality staff that made for an enjoyable experience the whole way through start to finish!Regards, Henry.
Heinz had an efficient, pleasant installation crew.They supplied a high quality, well installed system.

I am very happy with Heinz Solar.  They came out and quoted quickly, they were competitive with their pricing and the installation was carried out in a very professional manner. The guys were all really nice people (all from the Byron area) and they didn't use any sub-contractors aside from the legend who dug the trench for our cable run.

I am very happy with my solar installation through all steps of the process to quotation, installation and follow up.The sales rep, Liam, was such a nice fellow and extremely knowledgeable and professional. The installation team were also a bunch of nice guys and follow up has been great.I can only say youâ€™d be hard pressed to find a fairer company to deal with. Great product advice and service.
Great company to deal with. Heinz and his boys were very friendly, polit and professional. It was a pleasure to have the do my install.

Felt confident with choosing Heinz. After getting another cheaper quote they were able to drop their price a bit. What they installed was slightly different to what we were quoted due the panels being ceased in production. Havenâ€™t actually used the system yet as waiting for the smart metre but it looks good in the roof, excellent installation team, very professional
Liam was great to deal with. The installation process easy and straightforward. Highly recommend Heinz Solar

From the start to finish, Heinz Solar did a great job. The explanation from Heinz of the system, what we were getting, quality and price were all very good. The installation was carried out professionally, on time and all has been working as expected now for over 4 months. The whole system was ready to go from day one. All I had to do was change our electricity provider to take advantage of a good deal on the feed in tariff. I can fully recommend Heinz Solar to any future customers

My wife and I were excited yet hesitant to when it came to buying solar, luckily we were visited by a friendly, local and professional sales manager from Heinz Solar. Within the week we had signed the contract for our new 6.6kW system and three weeks later our system was installed by the Heinz crew - who were very respectful and proficient.

Easy to deal with during system specification and quoting. Clear and very knowledgeable. Great installation team who really took the time to get the job done right. Helpful in every aspect. I didnâ€™t have to lift a finger everything got connected and running really smoothly.
I was thrilled with the whole process and  have already completed this survey, Gail
Gave us prompt service. Staff was efficient and courteous and knowledgeable. Came for first clean and did an excellent job.
Very helpful regards information.
Heinz solor were very professional, quick to install, very neat and tidy, and a great company to deal with, highly recommend.

Very happy with the sales, service and installation from Hienz Solar, very pleasant company to deal with.Diappointed with the serivice from Origin Energy, promised tarif meter within 30 days, now 40 days and still waiting.

I don't think I would deal with any other vendor. Very knowledgeable and practical and always available to assist and advise. The installer team were very impressive and very good to deal with. The installation was over 3 days in temperatures in excess of 38C. I cannot praise the company and its team more highly.

Heinz and his team have done a great job.The process was made very easy and backed with prompt and professional service.Heinz and his team are easy to talk to and respond to any questions or concerns quickly and positively.

Heinz solar were the most knowledgeable company I dealt with. I liked the fact that the company were based locally, as were all the installers. We havenâ€™t had the system connected as yet - waiting on smart meter, but they were great to deal with.
Bit miffed that you did not refer anyone from my local area. Lismore NSW. Will not be likely to use or recommend you for other installs in this area....
Installers accidentally made a hole in my ceiling- but these things happen and was repaired and dealt with professionally
Heinz solar came all the way out to north west nsw just for us.  The service was the best I have came across in a long time. The quality is excellent. Highly recommanded. Top work guys
Heinz was the only supplier who followed through. He has designed a great system which will be installed shortly

The Solar quote website has provided me with all the info to confidently choose the best quote/system from the 3 suppliers suggested.All suppliers responded promptly.Heinz Solar was chosen as the best option regarding price/quality/advise and response to questions and concerns.The system is at this stage performing above expectation with the help of the added Fronius smart meter. Self consumption at this stage is around 70%.Finn thanks for your excellent website and keep going.Ignatius
I still haven't the system turned on yet....finished 28th March.The problem is with Origin and me not understanding the procedure.

Took some time to get OK from Essential Energy, six weeks from acceptance of quote to installation.Installation was very fast & efficient, the workmen were excellent at their job, no delays, having previously had solar this was something of a revelation at the speed & workmanship.Very satisfied. Pop
Great company to deal with, happy with the service provided, I recommend this company to install solar panels.
Was installed 10/11/16 ,as I said above I couldan't be happier with system
A whole lot of kW for not much money. Fantastic install. Looking forward to no more bills!

I have selected a hybrid battery system to integrate with existing 1.5 installation. Expect installation to commence end of October. Will provide further feedback after the system has been in operation over one power bill, possibly February 2017.
They are a local company. I knew the salesperson and the price was extremely good. The reason for the improvement in price was well explained and the installation was swift and efficient.

We were very happy with the two quotations received. They were quite competitive and included data and information we needed to help make a decision. Both people were also very prompt in supplying answers to our questions clarifying aspects we were not sure about.We have paid our deposit and now await the necessary approvals prior to installation.We also told each person that we would pass on their names to any people we met who were also wanting to have advice and quotes to install panels.
SAE took 3 weeks to respond to email request
Thank you for the service.  It was very efficient.

Thanks for the information from your site. Very helpful. I am a (retired) Technician, so possibly more picky than other PV consumers. I chose a superceeded Inverter (really cheap, but a reliable brand, Fronius). The Panels are Jinko, that I consider a better low cost option than buying Rolls Royce quality panels. Installed on Grace Racks. The main issues I picked up the installer on was that they did not protect the Earth wire correctly through the roof penetration (repaired), & I was extremely unhappy about the clamping of the interconnect conduit between the rows of panels on the roof: I would expect the conduit to be clamped to the racking using approved fixing methods. Initially the conduit was free floating (a fault if it was inspected). This was repaired by using metal cable ties to clip the conduit to the panels & racking. I am still not 100% happy, but it is satisfactory & safe.I recommend that customers get a safety inspection by a 3rd party after installation because most consumers would not be aware of these safety issues.One comment on my system: it is 13.5Kw of panels, 10Kw West facing, & 3.5Kw East facing. It is limited to 5Kw grid feed, but is averaging 40kWh/day in the middle of winter. This is returning better than bank (home loan) interest on my grid feed, with currently no self-consumption as building is under construction. When the building is finished, the Hot water will be heated by re-directed grid feed power (about 10KwH/day for 3 person use), & grid feed will be for excess over house immediate use. This PV system investment should repay in 4-5 years!
Heinz was easy to deal with. Always answered my questions promptly and honestly. We were happy to go with a small local company

Hienz and his team were great. They explained options, rebates, how the system would be installed, and the pricing.They scheduled the system installation very close to my making the deposit and the installation was completedfor a 100 panel system in one day.  The team came prepared, had everything they required, and only required about1/2 hour power outage to install the new meter.  It was far smoother than I ever anticipated. I would clearly recommend Heinz Solar and his teamof installers any time. Craig Anderson, CEO of The Sunglass Fix
Heinz was very helpful, and his team was very thorough
We went with a local company.  They turned up for quote on appointed time and the same with installation.

Heinz was extremely helpful, never difficult to question and he explained things for us brilliantly.Wouldn't hesitate to recommend him to anyone looking to add solar panels to their home or commercial building.cheers Heinz

There was a single incident in the whole process and Heinz was rapidly responsive and in fact he has at all times been very quick to answer my calls for information and assistance as much after as before installation. He goes out of his way to ensure a positive experience and I rate his involvement here very very highly indeed.  I have no hesitation in recommending Heinz Solar for customer service and satisfaction at a very competitive price point as well.  I will definitely give him the opportunity to offer his services when the time arrives to take my next step go fully off-grid.

A very professional job. The supplier attended my premises to assess the job and provide a quotation.All details were attended to by him. (Supply authority connections , new meter and STC's etc.The installation was completed in 2 weeks after I gave the go ahead.I would recommend this company wholeheartedly.
Very professional with a personal touch
Heinz didn't measure the roof size for the system we selected. 2 panels poke up above the roof line, one panel could not fit on.

A quality service from the first phone call right through to installation. Every question was answered in easy-to-understand detail, undertakings were met within the agreed timeframes, and the general customer attitude was outstanding.Would highly recommend.
The system isn't turned on yet so I hope it will work and there are no problems.

Because of the degree of pitch of our roof the installers broke 2 roofing tiles when they slid off the roof. Fortunately we had 2 spare tiles and thankfully no more were broken in the installation! We understood that this was not due to a fault of the installers.We were very impressed with the fellow, Jack, who was in charge of the installation.
